sections.automation_risks:
- **Knob auto-apply** would hit saturated bounds without fixing underperformance: `ai_judgment_fair` decision_review cites sector_cap already at **0.2** with no step left; `applied`: false despite cost_drag **14.6%** and excess **−19.04%** (`churn_health`, `learning_tracks_review`).
- **Breadth expansion early** (22 `research_markets`, P2 cascade) risks spending against **dedupe-heavy green produce**: ladder research `dedupe_skipped_count` **391**, `rememo_eligible_count` **0**, `executed` 6/`created` 6 while `remaining_usd_before` **59.3** — budget remaining is not demand met (`system_gaps.layers.produce`, `healthy_counter_distrust`).
- **Scaling agent decisions** without thicker PIT fields: `latest_analysis_review` flags assessment directional miscalibration; trajectory 1w hit_rate ~0.41 — opinion flips do not predict next-week price at scale.
- **Consumer-path miss hidden by green counters** (`system_gaps.flag_count` 0 but layers show risk): `apply.buy_tier_wired_count` **57**/65 with **`wired_missing_committed_verdicts` 1**; focus euro_depth memos **25/44** buy-tier with research spend skipping **fresh_memo** (`focus_library_research`, `library_policy.last_run.research.dedupe`); **`filing_ready` false on sp500** despite 51 unique_days and 67 observe snapshots — filing parity ≠ learning ready (`healthy_counter_distrust.filing_parity_is_not_learning_ready`).
- **Entry DCA execution path** remains gated: `entry_dca_adoption` stages block primary/live until `beat_market` and graduated book marks — auto execution would violate explicit `do_not` list.
sections.counterfactual_gaps:

- **Do live hold-recovery / swap-rotation policies beat alternatives on the primary book?** — live cohorts too small (6/0 closed); archive near-miss is ready but not directly comparable (`exit_timing_reconciliation`, `exit_timing_cohorts` vs `exit_timing_near_miss`).
- **Would exclusion step u4 have improved realized primary path?** — replay suggests +5.7% delta vs actual but only 9 entries; needs forward shadow observation artifact (`exclusion_ladder_replay`).
- **Does research overlay sim alpha survive costs?** — overlay sim deeply negative excess with 158 trades vs 8 on static levels (`simulation`) — counterfactual needs cost-aware hold-set frozen replay, not headline comparison_note alone.
- **Which failed thesis families drive avoid-cohort opinion flips?** — executive summary cites dividend/garp loser cards (12 each); needs offline family-weight stress (`experiment_assessment` ana-20260921-02).
- **`system_gaps.probe_questions`** (flags empty): learning consumer visibility; new-market inherit produce/persist/publish/apply miss; green counters with zero memo quality; rememo vs dedupe freshness; observe clocks on ingest-healthy markets; Sunday rememo scope for admitted buy-tier.

INGEST GAP CLOSURE REVIEW

**Single-ticker ingest gap-closure pass (FTSE library universe) — 25 runs (`igc-20260812-01` … `igc-20260817-04`, plus `trial-20260812-*` depth/rerun cousins):** All 25 show **`delta_filings_with_body` > 0** (e.g. `igc-20260813-02` **+43** JSG.L via investegate refetch). **Recommend PROMOTE** — eng-idle single-ticker gap closure on outstanding FTSE buy-tier gaps is validated; wire as default P1 orchestration when priority_score names have zero-body/indexed gaps (not spray on green sets).

**Single-ticker ingest depth trial — 10 runs (`trial-20260812-01` … `trial-20260812-11`):** Mostly **0** delta (e.g. `trial-20260812-01` MEGP.L); **+2** on `trial-20260812-09` JD.L, `trial-20260812-10` SBRY.L, `trial-20260812-11` EDV.L. **Recommend DEFER** depth-trial title as distinct from gap-closure pass — keep only when gap-closure queue empty and a named blocker needs max_bodies tuning; otherwise **DISMISS** repeat zero-delta tickers.

**Ingest trial rerun after engineering — 5 runs (`trial-20260812-04` … `trial-20260812-15`):** Mixed (**−13** VCT.L on `trial-20260812-04`, **+1/+2** on -06, -08, -15). **Recommend DEFER** — rerun only with explicit eng-id linked to source mapping change; **DISMISS** blind reruns on unchanged mappings.

**Single-ticker library ingest gap-closure pass — 196 runs (`igc-20260904-01` through `igc-20261101-01`):** **All 196** report **`delta_filings_with_body` 0**; dominant failure **`indexed_without_body`** (67 results), plus unmeasured/zero_body/thin (`igc-20261101-01` WIE.VI: `skipped_unfetchable` 1, indexed_without_body unchanged). **Recommend DISMISS** as repeated horizon_scan trials — no learning value in re-running identical intensive passes; **DEFER** engineering policy to classify unfetchable/indexed_without_body tails and stop auto-scheduling igc when `improved`: false (park as defer, not ingest-loop promotion).

**Library ingest gap-closure rerun after engineering — 4 runs (`igc-20260913-04`, -05, `igc-20260924-04`, plus one more):** **0** delta on SU.TO / SGO.PA etc. **Recommend DISMISS** unless eng ticket changes euro_filings regime for that ticker.
